visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair, wearing a grey crewneck t-shirt, appears in a rectangular inset in the upper right corner of the screen. He looks directly at the camera, speaking with an animated facial expression and occasional hand gestures. Below and behind him, a high-definition mobile MOBA game interface (Honor of Kings) is displayed. The game character, a red beetle-like hero, is moving through a lush green jungle environment with blue flora and rocky paths. Yellow and blue UI elements and a minimap are visible on the periphery. (2) The visual cuts to a replay sequence where the game screen is enlarged. The beetle-like character is seen engaging in a fast-paced battle with other colorful avatars in the center of the lane. Bright particles, health bars, and numerical damage indicators (e.g., 669) pop up frequently. The man's reaction inset remains in the corner, showing him grinning and leaning forward in excitement. (3) The scene shifts to a specialized replay view focusing on the minimap in the center-left. A red icon representing a vehicle moves rapidly across the map lanes, indicated by a glowing trail. The background shifts to a more zoomed-in view of the game world, highlighting a specific clash between heroes. Overlays with social media handles appear at the very bottom on a black bar. (4) The video returns to the original layout with the man narrating the outcome of the play. He points towards the screen while laughing. The gameplay at the bottom shows characters retreating from the battle area back into the jungle. The lighting is consistent throughout, reflecting bright, even studio light on the man and high-saturation digital colors in the game footage.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking enthusiastically in Mandarin over a light, upbeat electronic background track. A sharp "ding" sound effect from the mobile game occurs at the 1-second mark, serving as a transient trigger. The speaker's pitch is moderate, and his articulation is very clear. (2) As the gameplay intensifies at 5 seconds, a loud "boom" impact sound effect coincides with the character's skill usage. The background music continues with a steady 4/4 drum beat. The speaker's voice rises in pitch and volume, expressing excitement about a successful play. (3) At 13 seconds, the background music shifts abruptly to a high-tempo Eurobeat track ("Deja Vu"), characterized by fast-paced synths and a male vocal line in English. This marks a new phase as the speaker begins to laugh and mimic the car's sound with "Vrroom" noises. The audio event density increases significantly here. (4) Towards the end, the music transitions back to a more neutral electronic loop. The speaker provides a concluding comment with a lower arousal level and a more narrative, professional tone. The incidental sound of a keyboard or mouse click is faintly audible in the background as he finishes his thought.
